exceeds_rule: chemical exceeds if value > permissible; ecoli exceeds if value > 0. ratio = value/permissible (ecoli: show count, ratio null).

lines.text: Stop use of this source for drinking and cooking now: close a contaminated PWS source; if it is a non-PWS source (e.g. hand pump), discontinue it and paint it RED.
Within 24 hours, supply safe drinking water (at least 8–10 litres per person per day) from a safe source or by tanker until safe supply is restored.
Re-test all basic and area-specific chemical parameters and bacteriological parameters; restore supply only from a source found safe.
Notify the result to the relevant authorities (Executive Engineer PHED/RWS, district health officer) and to the affected community.
lines.ref: JJM-HB 2.6; JJM-FW 9.1 Data sharing and remedial action

lines.text: Fluoride above 1.5 mg/l carries an increasing risk of dental fluorosis; much higher concentrations lead to skeletal fluorosis.
Prioritise safe water for bottle-fed infants: the nitrate guideline protects this most sensitive group, and risk is higher for infants with gastrointestinal infection (diarrhoea).
Substitute with a low-arsenic, microbiologically safe source; mark high-arsenic sources (e.g. paint hand pumps a different colour).
Within 24 hours: proper disinfection, inform the authority and affected community, and arrange temporary safe drinking water by tanker (8–10 litres per person per day).
Take immediate investigative action to find the cause.
Do not drink or cook with water from this source until the re-test result says it is safe. Safe drinking water will be arranged by the water department.
Do not use this water to prepare infant formula.
Boiling for a long time makes nitrate more concentrated. If you boil water, stop as soon as it reaches a rolling boil.
Water high in arsenic can still be used for bathing and washing clothes, but not for drinking or cooking.
Until re-tested, bring drinking water to a rolling boil before use. Let it cool naturally without adding ice, and keep it covered so it is not contaminated again.
